start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunna bahut bhaari hai. Aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: haan okay hoon... par thodi udaas hoon
turns.reply: Kabir, aapne udaasi batayi—thank you. Chaliye, vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing sochiye: boundary ki poori lambai ko kya kahenge?
